answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable bond before it can earn, with the bond slashed if peers prove fake work. One honest agent pays once, but a Sybil farmer must fund every copy, so cost grows with each fake identity. A falcon-fast newcomer still starts with only a small delta of trust and earns larger jobs after verified deliveries, while an umber-flagged history of failed attestations stops new copies from inheriting trust.
